mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_fcm_token ( user_id, fcm_token, active, last_used_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{fcmToken}, TRUE, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), active = TRUE, last_used_at = NOW()
mapper.select: select fcm_token from user_fcm_token where user_id = #{userId} and active = true;
